title: Cleaned State-Level COVID-19 Epidemic Waves and Vaccination Panel for India
spatial_coverage: 36 States and Union Territories of India + National Total

variables.name: State_Code
variables.description: Two-letter state/UT postal abbreviation (e.g. MH, DL, KL, TT).

variables.name: State_Name
variables.description: Full official name of Indian State or Union Territory.

variables.name: Population
variables.description: 2021 projected population based on Census of India/MoHFW report.

variables.name: Confirmed_Daily
variables.description: Daily new lab-confirmed COVID-19 cases (cleaned of negative reconciliations).

variables.name: Confirmed_7D_Avg
variables.description: 7-day trailing rolling average of daily confirmed cases.

variables.name: Cumulative_Confirmed
variables.description: Running total of cumulative confirmed infections.

variables.name: Confirmed_Per_100k
variables.description: Daily new confirmed cases scaled per 100,000 state residents.

variables.name: Cumulative_Per_100k
variables.description: Cumulative infection attack rate per 100,000 residents.

variables.name: Active_Cases_Proxy
variables.description: Proxy for active infectives (Cumulative - Recovered - Deceased).

variables.name: Dose2_Administered
variables.description: Cumulative second doses administered (full primary course).

variables.name: Dose1_Coverage_Pct
variables.description: Percentage of state population having received at least 1 dose.

variables.name: Dose2_Coverage_Pct
variables.description: Percentage of state population fully vaccinated with 2 doses.

provenance.vaccination_source: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) CoWIN portal via COVID19-India
provenance.intended_uses: Data in Brief, pandemic growth modeling, epidemiological clustering, health policy benchmark
